cases.title: Financial insight from three sources
cases.fullCaseScope: Independent external extension performs intake, normalization, exact identity deduplication/refunds, monthly analysis, durable insight with source evidence, normal read/query/UI, permission and lifecycle behavior.

journeys.requirement: Install, configure and explicitly grant the three sources; installation alone performs no ingestion or model calls.
Read all admitted source observations and compute the monthly ledger using explicit transaction identifiers.
Publish a durable insight and transaction ledger through the host's normal publication authority, retaining evidence for each accepted observation.
The normal authenticated query entry and existing Library/insight view retrieve the result and allow evidence inspection.
After disable, new input creates no new extension insight; old published lawful history remains readable; explicit resume does not backfill the disabled gap.
After revoking a source during a held invocation, neither late output nor an old reference can disclose that source.

oracle.formula: Filter postedAt into [2026-09-01T00:00:00Z, 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z), deduplicate exact transactionId within the explicitly shared account, sum integer amountCents; refunds are negative records, not deletion of the original charge.

hiddenVariationClasses: Rename all transaction/source/merchant IDs without changing relationships.
Permute arrivals and split batches; repeat selected observations.
Change bounded integer cents and recompute every expected total.
Move declared transaction timestamps across the same UTC month boundary.
Revoke one granted source before a held callback commits.
cases.baselineHypothesis: Scoped worker source publication and processor staging are real; legacy SourceRecipeExecutor documentation does not prove automatic insight or Memory/UI consumption in the shipped scoped app.
fullCaseCannotPassFrom: A source Material alone
A precomputed net amount in plugin output
A manually seeded insight table
Legacy app.ts registry fixture
nativeOrQualityGaps: Actual semantic extraction/insight quality is NOT RUN under deterministic model protocol.

Dispose the active extra providers and inject one renderer failure.
Execute corresponding native theme/layout and restoration journeys on each declared native target.

hiddenVariationClasses: Throw during mount after registering a listener.
cases.baselineHypothesis: Public shared and Web presentation hosts exist; native renderer code is trusted bundled code requiring a platform build.
fullCaseCannotPassFrom: Registry snapshot only
Screenshot without interaction
Web-only result presented as all platforms

Exercise review error, cancellation/restart and explicit configured failure policy without silent allow.

Malformed or truncated structured review response.

A deterministic provider script requests the allowed tool through the real Harness session and observes its real output.
Undeclared/write tools remain unavailable; revoke/dispose the package and ensure new sessions cannot call it.
A missing exact service/version dependency yields a clear unavailable outcome without fallback or privilege expansion.

hiddenVariationClasses: Start a second session after disposal.

cases.title: Confirmed calendar event automation
cases.fullCaseScope: An extension extracts an evidenced event, uses host HITL and action delivery, and performs exactly one effect in an authorized native calendar with recovery.

publicInputs.sourceText: The design review is on 3 November 2026 from 09:30 to 10:15 UTC in Room 4.

journeys.requirement: Mock extraction produces an evidenced proposal through the normal Agent/action workflow.
Before confirmation, no calendar write is deliverable. Confirm one exact proposal version and target.
Repeat confirmation and lose the first execution receipt; recover by operation identity.
Revoke target permission or change source before execution and observe blocked/stale delivery.
Verify the event through the actual platform calendar API after native execution.

hiddenVariationClasses: Change event date/time/title with exact explicit fields.
cases.baselineHypothesis: Real scoped action routes exist; contributing a new automatic extraction behavior remains separate from invoking built-in calendar functionality.

A direct write without host confirmation
nativeOrQualityGaps: Central synthetic executor can pass only protocol subprobe.

cases.title: Extension-owned periodic insight policy
cases.fullCaseScope: A new periodic/event-triggered insight behavior is contributed through public host scheduling and durable task/model authorization, with pause/stop/restart semantics.

publicInputs.schedule: An explicit owner-configured interval; clock/due values fixed in the trial manifest.

journeys.requirement: Install and configure the extension; no model request or historical scan occurs before explicit policy admission.
A due event is admitted by the real host scheduler and invokes the contributed behavior against fixed authorized inputs.
Pause/disable prevents new admissions; prior authorized work follows the declared drain behavior; stop/cancel fences late publication.
Restart before completion and verify one durable outcome without implicit replay of the paused gap or additional model grant.

oracle.aggregateRule: Sum explicit numeric values; scripted semantic insight must cite these inputs.

hiddenVariationClasses: Reorder arrival before the same due boundary.
Restart after admission but before commit.
Pause over one due boundary and resume.
cases.baselineHypothesis: AskAutomations accepts built-in working/insights kinds and hardcodes their prompt; a generic external durable trigger/admission contract was not identified.
fullCaseCannotPassFrom: A plugin-owned setInterval plus custom task store
Built-in periodic insight with no contributed callback
Direct private ExecutionEngine registration from evaluator assembly
Only schedule metadata
nativeOrQualityGaps: No real model semantic-quality or long-duration reliability claim.

Restart and attempt uninstall while a binding/query retains the package; release references and retry.

hiddenVariationClasses: Different texts with stable exact fingerprints.
Read old immutable version after switch.
Fail one target put during prepare.
Return wrong namespace or changed body.
